CLI Version Policy

What this server tells pvault command-line clients when they check their version.

The CLI version policy could not be loaded.

Upgrade Procedure

Project Vault supports in-place upgrades via docker compose up -d with a newer image. The migration system applies only additive schema migrations automatically on startup — no destructive changes (column drops, renames, table drops) are ever applied automatically.

If a future version requires a destructive migration, an explicit offline procedure is documented in the runbook. Always back up before upgrading.

Users

Manage everyone across your organization and their project roles.

Machine key dormancy alerts

How long a machine-user API key can go unused before a dormancy alert fires (Security Alerts / Notifications inbox).

Changing this is not retroactive: alerts already fired under the old threshold are not reconciled or auto-dismissed when you change this setting.

Choose the option that controls this setting. Review its effect before saving.

User dormancy alerts

How long a user account can go without activity before a dormancy alert fires (Security Alerts / Notifications inbox).

Changing this threshold does not affect alerts already in your Dormant user alerts inbox.

Choose the option that controls this setting. Review its effect before saving.

Default language for new users

The display language new invited or self-signed-up users start with on their first login. This does not change any existing user's own language — each person's individual choice (Settings > Language) always wins going forward.
